theme_and_archetype.rationale: The app is a 'financial to-do list', not an analytics dashboard. It requires extreme clarity, maximum thumb-target sizes, and stark semantic colors to drive action. We use a crisp, tactile aesthetic to establish trust without feeling clinical.

rules: No generic sans like Inter or Roboto.
Never center-align financial data; left-align everything in the card for scannability.
Use extremely tight tracking on massive numbers (₹ amounts).
Card padding must be generous (p-5 or p-6).
If user cannot act in 1 thumb tap, redesign.

Header_and_Version_Toggle.details: Includes a dropdown (Shadcn Select/DropdownMenu) with options 'V2: Action Plan View' (selected) and 'V1: Dashboard View (Classic)'. Include the user_avatar on the right.

Sticky_Action_Plan.classes: sticky top-0 z-40 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200 p-4 shadow-sm
Sticky_Action_Plan.details: Displays 'Fix Your Portfolio' title. Include a textual/dot progress indicator like '● ○ ○ 1/3 completed' using text-slate-300 for inactive and text-slate-900 for active dots. Must be collapsible to save vertical space on scroll.

Action_Cards.classes: w-full bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-5 mb-4 shadow-sm
Action_Cards.details: Cards must span 100% width of the mobile container. Structure: Top row (Type Indicator dot + 'SELL/SWITCH/ADD' label), Second row (Massive ₹ Amount in Outfit font), Third row (Title), Fourth row (Reason & Impact). Bottom row: Huge CTA button filling the width.

states.PENDING: Uses the specific semantic color for its CTA.
states.COMPLETED: Card dims (opacity-60) and CTA changes to a disabled 'Completed' state with a checkmark.

Portfolio_Signals.details: Use Shadcn Accordion. Default state shows a compact summary row (e.g., 🔴 High Overlap, 🟡 Overexposure). Expanded state reveals details and ₹ impact. Keep it clean and data-focused without heavy charts initially.

Bottom_Action_Bar.classes: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-slate-200 p-4 flex gap-3 pb-8
Bottom_Action_Bar.details: Thumb-friendly zone containing 'Update Plan' (ghost/outline) and 'Simulate' (solid primary black) buttons. Both buttons must be h-14 to ensure easy reachability.

Loading_States.details: Use Shadcn Skeleton to block out the Action Cards and Signals. Must load instantly (< 2s perception) with pulsing blocks replacing the text and ₹ amounts.

motion_and_interactions.cards: opacity-0 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500 fill-mode-forwards
motion_and_interactions.stagger: Stagger the entrance of Action Cards (e.g., delay-100, delay-200).
motion_and_interactions.collapsible: Use smooth height transitions for Accordions and the Sticky Plan.

icons_and_media.usage: Use Duotone weight for a premium look, or regular weight for high clarity. Ensure icons inside buttons are 24px.

success_icon.description: 3D minimalist green checkmark icon to be shown when all actions are completed.

user_avatar.description: Professional user portrait for the header/profile section.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Example: data-testid='mark-done-button-sell'.
